title: kithctl watch: Last-Event-ID on reconnect uses JMAP state token, not SSE event ID
description: watch.rs:604-607: on reconnect after connection drop, last_event_id is set to last_message_state (a JMAP state token like s-42). SSE Last-Event-ID is a different namespace maintained by the SSE stream's own ID counter. Both happen to use the s-N format and pass is_valid_last_event_id, so it works today, but if kithd's SSE event counter and JMAP state counter diverge, the wrong namespace token is sent as Last-Event-ID and the server may replay wrong events or reject the reconnect.
